text:
lara: RFC follow-up re: tenant onramp + burst quotas. proposing a soft-start: small timeboxed burst then auto-escalate if behavior is clean. thoughts on where admission vs quota should own state?

ben: Admission should issue ephemeral grants, quota enforces counters. Keep admission logic minimal.

chung: Concern: account farming to milk bursts. Need heuristics at creation time: rate-limited signup, IP/netblock guardrails, require verified payment for higher caps.

lara: idea: admission returns grant token and telemetry id. quota service takes the grant token to validate counts. simplifies callers.

ben: For signals, use cached abuse scores + fast checks (signup velocity, spike in token use). Avoid sync calls on hot path.

chung: Add global proxy backstop that caps onramp per-ip and per-subnet to catch mass-creation. Also track metrics: onramp_issued, onramp_denied, burst_usage_by_org.

infra-bot: deploybot: feature-flag redwood.soft_onramp toggled -> staging

lara: next steps: write a short RFC, define grant proto, dashboard queries, rollout plan behind flag. will tag security & SRE for review. :thumbsup:
